Hello! I am a statistician specializing in computational methods, applied statistical methodology, and data visualization. I currently serve as a Lecturer in Department of Statistics at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln, where I teach undergraduate and graduate level courses, with an emphasis in computational statistics. 

I am currently seeking employment opportunities beginning on or after June, 2027.
